tools.name: merchant_api_call
tools.description: Call any documented Merchant API endpoint using a fixed Google service allowlist.

path.description: Relative API path only; full URLs are rejected.

dry_run.description: Preview the Merchant API request without changing data. Defaults to true.

confirm.description: Must be true with dry_run=false and MERCHANT_ENABLE_MUTATIONS=true before a write executes.

tools.summary: Call any documented Merchant API endpoint using a fixed Google service allowlist.
notes: Mutation execution requires dry_run=false, confirm=true, and MERCHANT_ENABLE_MUTATIONS=true; otherwise returns a request preview. GET through merchant_api_call executes without mutation gates.

Generic dispatcher supports GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE over fixed service allowlist. Non-GET methods are treated as mutations, including arbitrary POST. Optional beta/alpha service entries do not affect core v1 service registration.
Only the Google MCP server’s Merchant tools are included; the separate Clarity server is outside this catalog.
Writes default to previews. Execution requires dry_run=false, confirm=true, and MERCHANT_ENABLE_MUTATIONS=true.
Generic merchant_api_call includes alpha/beta service choices whose endpoint availability was not exercised; named core operations target Merchant API v1.
